subject: [RFC PATCH 27/57] mm/collapse: scan the windows a VMA can hold

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged algorithm to scan VMAs in a more efficient way by considering the largest order of windows that a VMA can hold, rather than only scanning PMD-aligned addresses. This change allows khugepaged to reach and collapse larger VMAs, including those with smaller THP orders enabled. The patch also removes unnecessary assertions and clamping logic.
